# Externally hosted benchmark instances

## MOAP and MOKP

The multi-objective assignment problem (MOAP) and multi-objective knapsack problem (MOKP) benchmark instances used in the paper originate from:

Kirlik, G. and Sayın, S. (2014). “A new algorithm for generating all nondominated solutions of multiobjective discrete optimization problems.” *European Journal of Operational Research*, 232(3), 479–488. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ejor.2013.08.001

The original benchmark-library website is no longer maintained. The instances and associated materials are available in the [Multiobjective Optimization Library mirror on GitHub](https://github.com/srplsyn/MOOLibrary), which provides the assignment (`ap.zip`) and knapsack (`kp.zip`) archives.

MOAP and MOKP files are intentionally not duplicated in this repository. Please consult the source library and publication for their provenance and usage.
